_comment: Lighthouse CI config. Consumed by .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml via the treosh/lighthouse-ci-action wrapper. Schema reference: https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci/blob/main/docs/configuration.md

settings._comment: Desktop preset matches the primary surface for an LLM chat app; mobile-first projects would flip to the mobile preset. Skip PWA-only audits since this app isn't a PWA (deliberate — LLM chat needs network).

assertions._comment_a11y: Hard error. Accessibility regressions block merges — a11y is a contract, not a preference. WCAG 2.1 AA bar.
assertions._comment_perf: Warning. Performance scores are network-sensitive and vary 5-10 points run-to-run on GitHub-hosted runners. Hard-gating perf produces flaky CI without surfacing real regressions.
assertions._comment_bp: Warning. Best-practices catches HTTPS, console errors, vulnerable libs — usually clean unless a real regression appears.
assertions._comment_seo: Disabled. The site is intentionally noindex'd (robots: noindex per the fair-use posture documented in the README), so an SEO score of ~60 is expected and not actionable.
assertions._comment_pwa: Disabled. Not a PWA by design.
